{"program":"domain(person,[iyla,eloise,christian,asher]).
% Iyla does not become an expert.
axiom(s1,not(become_expert(iyla))).
% If Iyla excels in experiments, then she will achieve success.
axiom(s2,implies(excels_in_experiments(iyla),achieve_success(iyla))).
% Iyla discovers new properties.
axiom(s3,discovers_new_properties(iyla)).
% Eloise conducts experiments.
axiom(s4,conducts_experiments(eloise)).
% Christian gains recognition or publishes research (or both).
axiom(s5,or(gains_recognition(christian),publishes_research(christian))).
% Anyone who has an innovative mind or works hard can excel in experiments.
axiom(s6,rule([or(has_innovative_mind(X),works_hard(X))],excels_in_experiments(X))).
% Asher does not become an expert.
axiom(s7,not(become_expert(asher))).
% If Iyla conducts experiments, then she either shares her findings or keeps her notes private, but not both.
axiom(s8,implies(conducts_experiments(iyla),xor(shares_findings(iyla),keeps_notes_private(iyla)))).
% If Iyla pursues her passion, then she either gains recognition or improves people's lives (or both).
axiom(s9,implies(pursues_passion(iyla),or(gains_recognition(iyla),improves_peoples_lives(iyla)))).
% Iyla conducts experiments.
axiom(s10,conducts_experiments(iyla)).
% A renowned alchemist excels in experiments.
axiom(s11,exists(var(x,person),and(renowned_alchemist(var(x)),excels_in_experiments(var(x))))).
% Christian does not achieve success.
axiom(s12,not(achieve_success(christian))).
% Iyla does not achieve success.
axiom(s13,not(achieve_success(iyla))).
% Iyla makes new findings or publishes research.
axiom(s14,or(makes_new_findings(iyla),publishes_research(iyla))).
% If Asher excels in experiments, then she will achieve success.
axiom(s15,implies(excels_in_experiments(asher),achieve_success(asher))).
% Asher discovers new properties.
axiom(s16,discovers_new_properties(asher)).
% If Iyla discovers new properties and shares her findings, then she becomes an expert.
axiom(s17,implies(and(discovers_new_properties(iyla),shares_findings(iyla)),become_expert(iyla))).
% Christian does not leave a lasting impact.
axiom(s18,not(leaves_lasting_impact(christian))).
% Christian either publishes her research or keeps her notes private, but not both.
axiom(s19,xor(publishes_research(christian),keeps_notes_private(christian))).
% Iyla either publishes her research or keeps her notes private, but not both.
axiom(s20,xor(publishes_research(iyla),keeps_notes_private(iyla))).
% If Eloise discovers new properties and shares her findings, then she becomes an expert.
axiom(s21,implies(and(discovers_new_properties(eloise),shares_findings(eloise)),become_expert(eloise))).
% Iyla gains recognition or publishes research (or both).
axiom(s22,or(gains_recognition(iyla),publishes_research(iyla))).
% If Iyla gathers data or analyzes results, then she will share her findings.
axiom(s23,implies(or(gathers_data(iyla),analyzes_results(iyla)),shares_findings(iyla))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(develops_innovative_remedies(iyla)),Status,Package)"}
